content.text:
## Summary

`e2e/responses.spec.ts` was written before groups on the responses admin page defaulted to collapsed (`54e3d189 SYS-584 Add sweet collapse function to ResponsesForm`), so it was trying to interact with player rows hidden inside a closed `Collapse`. Fixed:

- Added an `expandGroup(title)` helper that clicks a group's header (`aria-expanded`) when needed, and call it before every row interaction.
- Hardened `setResponseValue`: skip re-selecting an already-selected option (Mantine `Select`'s `allowDeselect` defaults to `true`, so clicking the currently-selected option blanks it instead of leaving it — this surfaced from shared fixture data across sequential Playwright projects), and retry the open→select sequence to tolerate the SSE-refresh race already noted in the file's comments.

Verified with two consecutive full runs (`npx playwright test e2e/responses.spec.ts`) — 15/15 passed both times — plus `typecheck`, `lint`, and `knip` all clean. No other files were touched.

One incidental finding worth a look sometime: `Select` on the responses form doesn't set `allowDeselect={false}`, so clicking an already-selected response option silently clears it (and `Update` then no-ops since `response` is null). Not fixed here — out of scope for this test update — but flagging in case you want it.

input.summary: ResponsesForm: clicking the already-selected Response option silently clears it
input.description:
**Component:** `src/components/ResponsesForm/ResponsesForm.tsx`

The `Select` used for the per-player "Response" field does not set `allowDeselect={false}`. Mantine's `Select` defaults `allowDeselect` to `true`, so clicking the currently-selected option in the dropdown deselects it, setting the field's value to `null`, instead of leaving it unchanged.

**Impact:**

If an admin opens the Response dropdown and clicks the option that's already selected (e.g. re-confirming a value, or a slightly imprecise click), the value silently becomes blank. If they then click **Update**, `handleSubmit` in `ResponsesForm.tsx` no-ops because of the `if (!responseValues.response) return;` guard — no request is sent, no error is shown, and no success notification appears either. The `Update` button can still appear enabled (dirty) because of unrelated changes (e.g. comment/goalie), giving no visual indication that the save silently failed.

**Repro:**

1. Go to `/footy/admin/responses` for a game with at least one player already set to a response (e.g. "Yes").
2. Open that player's Response dropdown.
3. Click "Yes" again (the currently-selected option).
4. Observe the Response field is now blank.
5. Click Update — nothing happens, no notification shown.

**Suggested fix:** add `allowDeselect={false}` to the `Select` in `ResponsesForm.tsx` (~line 265), since "None" is not a meaningful state to reach this way — the field should only become empty via explicit initial state, never via reselecting.

**Found while:** updating `e2e/responses.spec.ts` to account for the group collapse/expand behaviour added in `54e3d189` (SYS-584); the test had to special-case skipping reselection of an already-correct value to avoid tripping this.

content.text:
Created **SYS-603**: [ResponsesForm: clicking the already-selected Response option silently clears it](https://toastboy.atlassian.net/browse/SYS-603).

Covers the repro, impact (silent no-op save with no error shown), and the suggested fix (`allowDeselect={false}` on the `Select` around `ResponsesForm.tsx:265`).
